basics.name: Ebrahim Hamidi
basics.label: Senior React & Frontend Engineer
basics.summary: Senior React and Frontend Engineer with 7+ years of experience building high-performance web applications, data-intensive dashboards, and digital products. Expert in React, Next.js, TypeScript, Astro, frontend architecture, real-time interfaces, PWAs, internationalization, and automated testing. Improved rendering and load performance by up to 90% and owned products from technical design through production delivery.

highlights: Architect and deliver data-intensive operational dashboards using React, Next.js, TypeScript, Redux, and AG Grid.
Reduced initial loading and table-rendering latency by up to 90% through component refactoring, render optimization, state-management improvements, and removal of frontend bottlenecks.
Built reusable enterprise data tables with server-side pagination, multi-column filtering and sorting, inline editing, grouping, dynamic columns, selection, and export.
Implemented WebSocket-based updates for operational records, workflow progress, and status changes without manual refreshes.
Owned the BeyondGrow product website from frontend architecture through production launch using Astro.
Built a bilingual English/Thai experience and light/dark themes using localized navigation, scalable internationalization patterns, reusable design tokens, and theme-aware components.
Used Astro's server-first, low-JavaScript architecture, responsive components, semantic HTML, and asset optimization to support fast loads, strong Core Web Vitals, accessibility, and SEO.
Designed and developed a complex tour-leader dashboard using React, Next.js, and TypeScript for travel operations and tour-management workflows.
Improved data-heavy views by optimizing component rendering, state updates, and data-loading flows.
Translated complex requirements into responsive UI patterns for forms, structured travel data, and multi-step workflows in collaboration with product and design teams.
Led the end-to-end redesign of a high-traffic SIM-card marketplace using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, modernizing search, listing, seller, and purchasing workflows.
Improved performance across data-heavy pages by optimizing rendering, data fetching, component structure, and asset delivery.
Built advanced filtering across operator, prefix, SIM type, condition, payment method, seller type, and vanity-number patterns.
Enhanced Progressive Web App capabilities and added automated tests for critical components and business workflows.
